entries.name: DEP_MCU_BOARD_SUPPORT_MCU_EMBED_TEXTURES
entries.rationale: CompilerConfiguration::new reads this non-SLINT build-host input before PartMan applies explicit resource policy; the shared ambient guard and rerun set must reject it exactly.

entries.name: SLINT_ASSET_SECTION
entries.rationale: The compiler reads it only under software-renderer resource embedding, a forbidden compiler capability.

entries.name: SLINT_BACKEND
entries.rationale: Backend selection reads this at runtime; PartMan rejects ambient selection and later chooses Winit plus one renderer programmatically.

entries.name: SLINT_BUNDLE_TRANSLATIONS
entries.rationale: The compiler reads it only when bundle-translations is enabled; that compiler feature is forbidden.

entries.name: SLINT_COMPILER_DENY_WARNINGS
entries.rationale: Only slint-build reads this; slint-build is forbidden and PartMan's owned adapter fails on diagnostics directly.

entries.name: SLINT_CPP_NAMESPACE
entries.rationale: The compiler constructor reads it for C++ output; PartMan requests Rust output only.

entries.name: SLINT_DEBUG_PERFORMANCE
entries.rationale: Core rendering metrics can read it at runtime or compile time; release-shaped PartMan rejects both ambient paths.

entries.name: SLINT_DEFAULT_FONT
entries.rationale: Shared font discovery accepts an ambient primary font; PartMan must keep font choice explicit and reproducible.

entries.name: SLINT_DESTROY_WINDOW_ON_HIDE
entries.rationale: The Winit adapter changes window lifetime from this ambient value; PartMan rejects it.

entries.name: SLINT_EMBED_RESOURCES
entries.rationale: CompilerConfiguration::new reads it before PartMan's explicit resource choice; ambient state is rejected.

entries.name: SLINT_EMBED_TEXTURES
entries.rationale: CompilerConfiguration::new can enable compile-time texture embedding from this value; PartMan has no such assets and rejects it.

entries.name: SLINT_EMIT_DEBUG_INFO
entries.rationale: CompilerConfiguration::new changes generated debug metadata from this value; PartMan configures diagnostics explicitly.

entries.name: SLINT_ENABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_FEATURES
entries.rationale: CompilerConfiguration::new can enable experimental language behavior; the candidate forbids it.

entries.name: SLINT_FONT_PATH
entries.rationale: Shared font discovery accepts ambient fallback paths; PartMan rejects host-dependent font inputs.

entries.name: SLINT_FONT_SIZES
entries.rationale: Glyph embedding reads it only with compiler software-renderer paths, which are forbidden.

entries.name: SLINT_FULLSCREEN
entries.rationale: Window items read it at runtime and could bypass an explicit presentation state.

entries.name: SLINT_INCLUDE_GENERATED
entries.rationale: The public include_modules macro reads it, but PartMan includes its fixed OUT_DIR file directly and never invokes that macro.

entries.name: SLINT_INLINING
entries.rationale: CompilerConfiguration::new changes generated structure from this ambient value; PartMan's adapter chooses explicitly.

entries.name: SLINT_LINE_BY_LINE
entries.rationale: The Winit software renderer changes its buffer path when set; ambient renderer debugging is forbidden.

entries.name: SLINT_LIVE_PREVIEW
entries.rationale: Both Rust and C++ generators can divert to live-preview output; PartMan forbids live preview and uses Rust AOT output.

entries.name: SLINT_MACRO_CACHE
entries.rationale: slint-macros reads it only for the slint! expansion cache; PartMan never invokes slint!.

entries.name: SLINT_SCALE_FACTOR
entries.rationale: The compiler and Winit runtime both read it; ambient scale must not alter generated input or runtime DPI behavior.

entries.name: SLINT_SLOW_ANIMATIONS
entries.rationale: Core animation timing reads it at runtime; PartMan's reduced-motion behavior must be explicit instead.

entries.name: SLINT_SOFTWARE_RENDERER_PARLEY_DISABLED
entries.rationale: The software renderer changes text layout implementation from this ambient value; renderer qualification must be reproducible.

entries.name: SLINT_STYLE
entries.rationale: The compiler and slint! macro can accept an ambient widget style; PartMan explicitly selects Fluent and never invokes slint!.

entries.name: SLINT_WGPU_CPU
entries.rationale: WGPU adapter selection reads it only on forbidden WGPU/Skia paths.

entries.name: SLINT_WIDGETS_LIBRARY
entries.rationale: i-slint-compiler's own build script creates this exact rustc environment value and fileaccess includes it; downstream ambient input is neither accepted nor required.
